actual_failure.error: CatBoostError: catboost/libs/metrics/metric.cpp:6822: If non-default weights for objects are not set, the 'use_weights' parameter must not be specified.

evidenced_cause: Closed job is classification macro_f1, nested_stopping=true, early_metric=primary, CatBoost1000/.05/depth6/l2=3. Neither class_weight_power, class_weights nor data_policy is present. The prose hypothesis claims mild weighting, but actual parameters do not enable it.
Frozen CatBoost adapter line23 unconditionally sets TotalF1:average=Macro;use_weights=false for primary MacroF1. create_model weighted=false and auto_class_weights=None for this exact job.

sample_weights returns None when class_weight_power is absent. Default DataPolicy is noop; prepare_training returns the same None weights. Worker adds sample_weight only when weights is not None. Thus this exact job creates no object-weight path.
Closed worker traceback reaches inner nested fit_on_rows -> estimator.fit -> CatBoost _train and raises the explicit use_weights rejection. No predictions or labels were inspected.

minimal_fix.scope: Only omit explicit use_weights on provably unit/unconfigured weight paths; retain all configured weighted paths byte-for-byte in metric strings.
minimal_fix.no_weight_path: legacy auto_class_weights disabled AND clipped class_weight_power=0/absent AND exact DataPolicy.is_noop.
minimal_fix.unweighted_macro_f1: TotalF1:average=Macro without explicit use_weights on that path; all objects have unit weights, so its objective remains the same unweighted MacroF1. Accuracy gets the identical applicability guard.
minimal_fix.weighted_behavior: Any legacy auto-class weighting, positive power or non-noop policy retains ;use_weights=false exactly. Training/sample/class weights and objective/evaluator/gates are not changed.
minimal_fix.limit: This is intentionally a narrow fix for the evidenced no-weight failure. A configured weighted path can still yield trivial actual weights (e.g. balanced class counts or a noop-effect policy); create_model cannot inspect realized fit weights. Such a preexisting edge case is not claimed fixed and would require a separate actual-fit-weight contract change.

future_one_focused_fixture_test.when: After active production queue and ownership cleanup close, under a new root-reviewed prospective source declaration; no current-run repair or retry.
future_one_focused_fixture_test.test: One fixed synthetic imbalanced multiclass fixture with two subcases: no weight path and a positive class_weight_power path, disjoint tiny training/evaluation positions.
future_one_focused_fixture_test.bounds: At most2 tiny CatBoost fits,10iterations each,1thread,<=64synthetic rows,30s parent,512MiB; no API/network/current data.
checks: Unit-weight subcase constructs eval_metric TotalF1:average=Macro, fits without original error, metric equals unweighted MacroF1 from fixed held-out fixture labels/predictions.
Weighted subcase retains exact ;use_weights=false, sample weights come only from fitting labels, and reported held-out metric remains unweighted MacroF1.
No regression/learner/objective/gate parameters changed. Capture errors/timeout/null metrics, never silently treat failure as zero.
